messages:
emily: Heads-up — visiting client Mr. Chen (Shanghai Bio) arriving Thu 09:30. He's bringing a small catered breakfast + one oversized poster tube. Needs an accessible seat near the elevator and preferably space to lay the poster flat.

ryan: Got it. Was catering ordered through MorningBrew?

jess: Yep, I ordered it last week. Caterer ETA 09:10, they'll ring the buzzer. Poster tube is ~1.2m, fairly heavy. Front desk, can you accept and label?

frontdesk-bot: Automated: Incoming items logged for Mr. Chen — 1 x Poster Tube (1.2m), 2 x Catering Boxes. Items held at front desk. ID required. Storage suggestion: back closet (6th floor) or locker C3. Recommend trolley for heavy item.

reception-bot: Reception note: Trolley reserved. I've also reserved south window desk on 6F (closest to elevator) as accessible seating. Will print a visitor badge with accessibility flag.

emily: Also need a visitor parking pass in Lot B for a rental car — plate GHT-334, valid ~2 hours. Can someone activate?

ryan: Parking pass added for GHT-334 08:45-11:00. QR pass sent to host via DM.

jess: Quick favor: can the standing whiteboard in 6B be moved next to the south desk? Client wants to sketch.

emily: @ryan (facilities) — can you coordinate? wrong channel, oops.

ryan: I'll get facilities to move the board before 08:45 and confirm here.

jess: Flags: if poster won't fit upright in elevator, please use service entrance and bring horizontally. @facilities to confirm clearance.

reception-bot: Visitor record updated: accessibility seat, poster handling instruction, catering placed in locker C3. Locker code DM'd to host. Physical badge printed and placed at front desk at 09:15 if needed.

frontdesk-bot: Reminder: Mr. Chen check-in timestamp 1769854200 (Thu 09:30). Packages and catering logged.

emily: Thanks all. I'll meet them at the desk. Please DM the locker code to me rather than posting it here.

ryan: Locker code DM'd. Facilities confirmed service entrance clearance and trolley availability.

jess: all set. :thumbsup:
